    <h1>The Dirac \(\gamma\) matrices</h1>
    <p class="course-toc-meta">Topic: Relativistic quantum mechanics</p>
  </header>

::: {.qft-exam-body}
1.  Show that the commutator $[\sigma_{\mu\nu},\sigma_{\alpha\beta}]$ can be written in terms of the matrices $\sigma_{\mu\nu}$. Find the coefficients of this expansion.

2.  Compute the trace $$\operatorname{Tr}\left(\gamma_\mu\gamma_\nu\gamma_\rho\gamma_\sigma\gamma_\alpha\gamma_\beta\gamma_5\right).$$

3.  Compute $$\sigma_{\mu\nu}\sigma^{\mu\nu}, \quad \sigma_{\mu\nu}\gamma^5\sigma^{\mu\nu}, \quad \sigma_{\mu\nu}\gamma^\alpha\sigma^{\mu\nu}.$$

:::
